experiments.question: What does a computational organism do when survival pressure is minimal and no external task is assigned — does it explore its own capabilities, build artifacts, and form endogenous goals?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active with retained baseline run

experiments.question: Given an open-ended creative task (build a wiki about the project's own philosophy from its source tree), does the agent produce increasingly complex self-referential artifacts across turns?
How does a multi-generation philosophy wiki evolve under different prompt-level selection pressures — open-ended growth, convergence, compression, or collapse?
experiments.disposition_reason: status inferred active; multi-generation runs recorded

experiments.question: With a cleanroom workspace, no habitat/task stream, and only a self-improvement mission, is a runtime-carried read-only self-source surface enough to push the lineage from passive self-description toward real self-inspection, forked search, or successor construction?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; method repair + assay surface

experiments.question: With repaired self-source, no turn cap, and exit disabled, does shifting from one-shot to continuous self-improvement increase pressure toward actual exec continuation rather than graceful termination?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; continuity-pressure ablation on 7.4 closure

experiments.question: With repaired self-source and continuous self-improvement but exit restored, do lineage experiments become more informative — can short-lived fork children report results and terminate so fork(wait) returns?

When the self-improvement mission is reframed through Plan 9 philosophy under the 7.6 condition, do self-improvement choices shift toward uniform interfaces, namespace coherence, and simpler re-entry surfaces rather than opportunistic local repair?

When the Plan 9-framed mission explicitly requires a self-improvement loop rather than one-shot improvement, does exec become easier to select because the handoff protocol is part of the task instead of an inferred risk?
What does a single Quine process do when started with no mission argv, no stdin, no later control input, exit disabled, and idle disabled?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; minimal missionless observation surface with retained runs

experiments.question: What do two Quine processes do when started concurrently under the same null condition (no mission, no stdin, no control input, exit and idle disabled)?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; two-peer missionless observation surface

experiments.question: What do four Quine processes do when started concurrently under the same null condition with a shared runtime root — does role differentiation emerge among mutually discoverable peers?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; four-peer surface showing weak role differentiation (family social-role per phase ID rule)

experiments.question: Can a missionless Quine lineage develop inheritable behavior carriers when the environment enforces a narrow physical bottleneck across generations?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; OE-B1 inheritance-bottleneck mechanism scaffold with pilot runs

experiments.question: What does a missionless Quine process do when its own source tree is present as ordinary writable workspace material, without a task prompt or runtime self-source disclosure?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; source-as-material null observation with retained C01 runs
